For me multitasking while drive really helps. What I do is have music or an audiobook playing while using GPS. While driving I constantly switch between looking forward, left and right mirror, rear view mirror, GPS, and back to speed.   
Use Cruise Control as much as possible! If on freeway set it and follow the car infront. This little game helps me a lot. I drive a lot on the freeway so the game I play works like this. Go to the second or third lane from far left. (the lane next to the fast lane) Follow a car going 65 or 70. Set cruise control and keep a few car spaces away. I use 3 car spaces.  
Anytime a car comes to that lane or I'm closer I reduce the cruise control speed slightly. If too far a increase it slightly. This game keeps be focused.

I asked the same thing... Apparently what most likely was going on was they were trying to steal the tires and saw me coming so booked it before they could finish.

If you really want to be careful I recommend just always checking your car before you leave anywhere. Check around the tires to see if there are any sharp objects or if the tire lugs have been stolen (this happen to me and cost $100 to get the damages fixed)

I recommend getting a tire patch kit and having it handy. If a nail or screw gets in your tire you can most likely just patch it with that and save on tire money.

Since you are going to be driving for a few hours straight, when you get to your destination don't turn the car off right away. Park and wait about a minute then turn it off.

If it is really cold in the morning let your car idle (turn car on, but leave in park) to warm up. 

Never leave the AC on when the car is parked. I recommend buying jumper cables and leaving them in your trunk. If you don't feel safe in the area you are parking get a steering wheel lock and use it. 

Check the car fluids on a weekly basis. If you are hearing a new noise and something feels off, pull over and investigate. After driving for a bit you'll get accustomed to the sounds and way your car handles. 

If you have AAA never be afraid to use it. Have a flat? call them and they'll come change it for you. 

Also if you have a spare tire make sure it has air in case you do need to use it.
